assigned_cases.name: allocation_lease_adversarial_cases
assigned_cases.proof_note: The 65,536 active-record cap covers initial buffers and replacement overlap, and boundary tests show a replacement can overlap exactly at the cap when one old record is freed. Tests verify actual capacity tags, old/new overlap peak and release, source/job/tracker identity, stale/double release, budget rejection, checked arithmetic, native Vec CapacityOverflow, cancellation cleanup, typed zero initialization and conservative physical/history retention. The reserve failure is induced by the real fallible Vec API at its capacity limit; no allocator fault injection or OS-level OOM is claimed.
